cards.vietnamese: Lớp vật liệu cách nhiệt (giữ ấm mùa đông, mát mùa hè)
cards.definition: Material used to prevent heat from entering or escaping a building.
cards.example: Thick roof insulation keeps the eco-house warm in winter.

cards.vietnamese: Bền vững, thân thiện với môi trường & Tái chế
cards.definition: Able to be maintained without harming the environment.
cards.example: Using recycled glass and timber makes construction sustainable.

exercises.question: Material installed in roofs and walls to stop heat from escaping is called ________.
Eco-friendly architects choose recycled timber ________ protect ancient rainforests.
exercises.explanation: Infinitive of purpose: to + V0 (to protect).
